1.visual: An upward-pointing arrow emerging from a tray or inbox shape — a thick arrow pointing up sits above a rectangular container open at the top, resembling a document being lifted out of a slot.
1.usage: Upload a file or asset, share content to a platform, export data from a local store, send a document from a device.

2.visual: A laptop computer outline with a checkmark inside the screen area — the lid and keyboard base are shown in profile, and a bold tick mark fills the screen cavity.
2.usage: Confirm a device task is complete, indicate a successful deployment or build, mark a laptop or desktop as verified, show an approved remote session.

3.visual: A large X formed by two diagonal lines crossing at the center of the icon, with rounded or slightly tapered ends on each line stroke.
3.usage: Close a dialog or modal, dismiss a notification or toast, remove a tag or chip, cancel an ongoing action.

4.visual: A magnifying glass with a plus sign inside the circular lens — the handle extends to the lower right, and the plus symbol is centered within the circle.
4.usage: Zoom in on a map or image, increase text size, add a search filter, expand a detail view.

5.visual: A magnifying glass with a minus sign inside the circular lens — identical in shape to a standard search icon but with a horizontal dash replacing the typical center detail.
5.usage: Zoom out on a map or image, decrease text size, remove a search filter, collapse a detail view.
